name: Xenazoic Acid

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France and Belgium, first in 1965 — for liver harm

summary: Xenazoic Acid was removed from the market in France and Belgium starting in 1965 because of harm to the liver [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a medium risk score of 59 for liver problems [M]. The same computer model also estimated a low risk score of 20 for heart problems [M].
